title: Reading lab: Luke 7:36–50
subtitle: Read contrast and evaluation within a longer scene.
overview: Luke’s scene asks you to follow a narrative interruption, an inner objection, and Jesus’ comparative evaluation. Do not flatten the contrast into one isolated saying.
Use the surrounding speech to identify the antecedents of pronouns and the force of the question-and-answer sequence.

items.grc: τίς καὶ ποταπὴ ἡ γυνὴ ἥτις ἅπτεται αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἁμαρτωλός ἐστιν;
items.en: Who and what sort of woman is this who touches him, since she is a sinner?

items.grc: οὗ χάριν λέγω σοι, ἀφέωνται αἱ ἁμαρτίαι αὐτῆς αἱ πολλαί, ὅτι ἠγάπησεν πολύ.
items.en: Therefore I say to you, her many sins have been forgiven, because she loved much.
